narrative.details: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
narrative.objectives: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hm... what a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all three cities, who knows what we could accomplish?
narrative.requestItemsText: You're practically glowing, friend. What do you have there?
